title: Accounts Assistant
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
You will be joining a well-established international manufacturing business with operations across Europe and a reputation for delivering high-quality products to a global customer base.Due to additional resource requirements within the finance team, an opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join the business on a permanent contract. This role offers excellent exposure across transactional finance, reconciliations and month-end support within a structured and supportive finance environment.Your new role
Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the finance department.This is a varied position combining Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Credit Control and Finance Administration responsibilities, offering broad exposure across the finance function.Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase and sales invoices
- Managing supplier invoice processing and resolving discrepancies
- Allocating customer payments and cash receipts
- Supporting credit control activities and chasing outstanding payments
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding account queries
- Processing invoices through SAP and ensuring supporting documentation is complete
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting documentation
- Performing supplier, customer, intercompany and bank reconciliations
- Supporting month-end accounting processes
- Assisting with accruals, prepayments, fixed assets and management account schedules
- Producing reports and supporting management presentations
- Providing general administrative support to the wider finance team

What you'll need to succeed
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar finance role
- Purchase Ledger and/or Sales Ledger experience
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills
- Experience processing invoices and completing reconciliations
- Good numerical and analytical skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong communication and organisational skills
- Ability to work independently and manage workloads effectively

Desirable
- Credit Control experience
- SAP experience
- AAT qualification or studies
- Exposure to month-end processes

What you'll get in return
- Opportunity to join a large international business
- Broad exposure across transactional and month-end accounting activities
- Experience working with SAP and multi-entity operations
- Supportive finance team
- Career development opportunities
- Exposure to management reporting and financial analysis

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click "Apply Now" to submit your CV, or contact William Loring at Hays Accountancy & Finance for a confidential discussion.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Our client is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to join their finance team on a fixed-term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional looking to develop their accounting skills within a busy and supportive environment.

The successful candidate will play a key role in the day-to-day running of the finance function, supporting a variety of transactional and month-end accounting activities. This position would suit someone who enjoys working with numbers, has strong Excel skills, and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records.

Key Responsibilities
- Process and manage purchase and sales invoices accurately within the accounting system.
- Handle invoice processing and ensure supporting documentation is complete and compliant.
- Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Allocate customer payments and cash receipts to customer accounts.
- Assist with credit control activities, including chasing outstanding payments.
- Review customer account information and credit limits where required.
- Respond to customer, supplier and internal finance queries.
- Support month-end accounting processes and preparation of financial information.
- Perform account reconciliations, including supplier, customer, bank and intercompany accounts.
- Assist with maintaining schedules for fixed assets, prepayments, accruals and operating expenses.
- Maintain accurate financial records and provide administrative support to the finance team.
- Contribute to financial reporting and support wider finance projects when required.

About You
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar finance role.
- Experience of purchase ledger and/or sales ledger processes.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills (essential).
- A good understanding of invoice processing, reconciliations and financial administration.
- Excellent numerical and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- The ability to manage workloads effectively and meet deadlines.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and resolving discrepancies.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Experience
- Previous credit control experience.
- Experience using SAP or a similar ERP/accounting system.
- Studying towards, or holding, an accounting qualification such as AAT.

What's On Offer
- Salary of £30,000 - £32,000 depending on experience.
- Opportunity to gain valuable experience within a busy finance function.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Exposure to a broad range of accounting and finance activities.
- Opportunity to develop your technical accounting skills and progress your finance career.

If you're an organised and motivated Accounts Assistant looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to be considered.

Brook Street NMR is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Trainee HR Administrator
description:
Thinking About a Career Change? Why Not Choose HR?

If you've reached a crossroads in your professional life and are looking for a fresh start in a people-focused, rewarding industry then Human Resources might be exactly what you're looking for.

Many of our candidates come from diverse professional backgrounds retail, customer service, administration, healthcare, education, hospitality, and more. What they all have in common is the desire to do meaningful work, support others, and build a stable, long-term career.

Our HR Career Change Programme

We specialise in helping individuals transition into HR-starting with recognised qualifications and ending with real job opportunities.

Whether you're working full-time, part-time, or in between roles, our online learning and personalised recruitment support can help you make a successful move into the HR profession often in just a few months.

Please note that this is a training course and fees apply.

Why Human Resources?

The HR profession is growing steadily across all sectors. As businesses put more focus on employee wellbeing, development, and company culture, skilled HR professionals are more important than ever.

Even entry-level roles in HR offer strong salaries, clear progression routes, and opportunities to specialise over time (in areas like learning & development, recruitment, employee relations, and more).

Here are typical UK salaries at various stages of the HR journey:
- HR Administrator - £27,000+
- HR Assistant - £30,000+
- HR Officer - £35,000+
- HR Advisor - £38,500+
- HR Manager - £55,000+

And with hybrid and remote roles increasingly common in HR, the flexibility is there too.

How It Works - Your 3 Step Journey Into HR

Step 1 - CIPD Level 3 Certificate in People Practice

The CIPD Level 3 Certificate in People Practice is the industry-standard entry point into Human Resources. It's assignment-based (no exams), and is delivered fully online with expert tutor support.
- Accredited by the Chartered Institute of Personnel & Development (CIPD)
- Covers recruitment, employee relations, HR systems, and more
- Complete in approx. 10-12 weeks at your own pace

This course not only boosts your employability-it also gives you the confidence and credibility to take the leap into a new industry.

Step 2 - Tailored Recruitment Support

Once you're qualified, our Recruitment Support Team will help you translate your background and new qualification into real job opportunities.

We've been helping career changers break into new roles since 2007-and our 4.8 Trustpilot rating shows how serious we are about your success.

You'll get:
- A professionally written, HR-focused CV
- Job-matching advice tailored to your experience and location
- Application support, interview prep, and mock interviews
- Ongoing 1-to-1 guidance to help you land your first HR role

Step 3 - Start Your New HR Career

Most of our candidates secure their first HR job within 3-6 months of qualifying-and often sooner if they're based near a major town or city.

And to give you confidence, we offer a Money Back Guarantee:
If we can't help you secure a role within 12 months of passing your qualification, we'll refund your training fees.

Flexible, Affordable, Achievable

To make things easier, we offer flexible payment options to spread the cost of your training over 12 months-so you can get qualified without financial pressure.

Ready to Make the Change?

Enquire now and one of our experienced Career Consultants will contact you within 4 working hours to answer your questions and help you take the first step towards a new, rewarding career in Human Resources.

title: HR administrator
salary_text: £29000 - £30000 per year (Pro rata for 3 month contract)
description:
My client, based in Neath near Swansea, is currently looking for an organised and detail-oriented HR Administrator to join their team on a temporary basis for an initial 3-month contract, with the potential to extend as the business continues to grow.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with previous HR administration experience to support the HR team with day-to-day processes, employee records and general HR support within a busy manufacturing environment.

Duties and Responsibilities
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the HR team, ensuring HR processes run efficiently and effectively.
- Maintain and update employee records, ensuring all information is accurate, confidential and up to date.
- Assist with the preparation of HR documentation, including employment contracts, offer letters, variations to contracts and other employee correspondence.
- Support the on boarding process for new employees, including preparing documentation and ensuring all relevant checks are completed.
- Assist with the administration of absence management, holidays, sickness records and attendance monitoring.
- Support the coordination and administration of disciplinary, grievance and performance management processes.
- Maintain HR databases, spreadsheets and employee files, ensuring compliance with data protection requirements.
- Assist with the preparation of HR reports and the collation of key HR metrics, including employee turnover, absenteeism and headcount.
- Provide administrative support for payroll preparation, employee benefits and other HR-related activities.
- Assist with communicating HR policies, procedures and updates to employees and managers.
- Keep up to date with relevant HR processes and employment legislation.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider HR team and assist with HR projects and business improvement activities as required.

Experience and Skills
- Previous experience in an HR Administrator or strong admin role.
- Experience working within a production or manufacturing environment would be advantageous.
- A good understanding of HR administration processes and employee lifecycle activities.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Excel.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to handle confidential information professionally and sensitively.
- A proactive approach, with the ability to manage workloads and prioritise tasks effectively.
- CIPD qualification or working towards CIPD would be advantageous.

The Opportunity

The company offers an excellent working environment and the opportunity to gain valuable experience within a busy HR team.

The role will be fully site-based in Neath, and being a car driver is preferable due to the location.

Immediate start available.

Please contact our office for further information or to discuss the opportunity in more detail.

title: Customer Service Advisor - Welsh Speaking/Written
description:
Job Title: Customer Service Advisor - Fluent Welsh Speaking and Written

Location: Remote
Contract Type: Temporary
Working Hours: Full-time, 6-week rolling rota (Shifts between 8am-8pm Monday to Friday, and 9am-5:30pm Saturday/Sunday/Bank Holidays. One Saturday and one Sunday every 6 weeks.)

Exciting Opportunity Awaits!
Our client is seeking a dedicated Customer Service Advisor to provide vital support to customers during their time of need. This role involves being the first point of contact for both inbound and outbound calls, ensuring each customer interaction is handled with care and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage customer inquiries via telephone, email, and webchat, updating the system with call notes.
- Deliver exceptional service by proactively addressing concerns and aiming for first-time resolutions.
- Support customers in sensitive circumstances while maintaining professionalism and impartiality.
- Identify complex queries and escalate them to ensure fair outcomes.
- Adhere to company guidelines while providing clear and efficient responses.
- Update client systems accurately with all key information.
- Navigate multiple secure client systems to retrieve and record information.
- Ensure compliance with GDPR and data protection requirements.
- Conduct security checks and verify customer identities before discussing sensitive information.
- Maintain confidentiality and accuracy while managing sensitive information.
- Meet performance targets related to quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
- Identify and report potential security, fraud, or safeguarding concerns.

What You Will Need:
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience in a fast-paced customer service environment (preferably within a contact centre).
- Strong IT skills and multitasking abilities.
- Excellent timekeeping and reliability.
- A suitable home-working environment with a quiet workspace and reliable broadband connection.

What Our Client Offers:
- Long-term ongoing assignments with regular opportunities for permanent roles.
- Up to 33 days of paid holiday per year (25 days plus 8 bank holidays).
- Weekly pay for your convenience.
- Access to Serco Mental Health & Wellbeing resources and inclusive support networks.
- Employee Assistance Programme to support your well-being.

Requirements for the Recruitment Process:
To participate in the recruitment process, candidates must provide:
- A full valid passport.
- Two proof of addresses.
- Evidence of living in the UK for the last 3 years.
- Proof of national insurance (P45/P60 or payslip).

Successful candidates will be required to undergo a BPSS check, including Right to Work checks, employment history verification, a DBS criminal record check, and a CTC Counter Terrorism Check.

Training Details:
- Training will consist of two weeks (Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm) followed by two weeks of on-the-job training with additional support.

This opportunity is perfect for enthusiastic individuals eager to make a difference in customer service while enjoying the flexibility of remote work. If you possess the required skills and qualities, consider applying for this exciting role!

Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

title: Planning Administrator
description:
Planning Administrators - Why You Should Apply

An extra day off every month: This Planning Administrator role comes with an industry-leading flexitime scheme. After probation, you earn an extra day off every month. That's up to 12 extra days a year, plus 32 days' holiday, for family, hobbies, or a long weekend away.

Learn from people who've done it: You won't be dropped in at the deep end. The manager you report to has done this exact job. The training and support are genuinely there when you need them.

Perks that save real money: An electric vehicle lease scheme at reduced cost, plus a nursery support scheme that can save you thousands a year, and a health cash plan covering dental, optical and physio.

A varied, connected role: You'll be the go-to point of contact across the whole site. One minute you're out on the shop floor, the next you're talking orders with customer service and purchasing.

Your salary, benefits & hours of work
- Competitive salary, depending on experience
- Days: Monday to Friday, 8am to 4pm, office-based in Bridgend
- 24 days holiday plus 8 bank holidays (32 days in total)
- Flexitime scheme: earn an extra day off every month once past probation
- Salary sacrifice pension (3% employer, 5% employee)
- Electric vehicle lease scheme, plus a tech purchase plan
- Nursery support, health cash plan and confidential counselling
- Free on-site parking with EV charging points

What you'll do as the Planning Administrator

As part of the operations team at an award-winning manufacturer, you'll keep information flowing between production, purchasing, and customer service so orders are met on time.
- Allocate realistic dates to customer orders, keeping track of what's already promised
- Update demand and production scheduling information in the ERP system (SAP)
- Monitor open orders and flag potential shortages or delays early
- Keep spreadsheets, trackers and business data accurate and reliable
- Work closely with the shop floor, orders and purchasing teams to keep everyone informed

What you'll need to apply for the Planning Administrator
- Experience in a manufacturing environment, ideally in supply chain, logistics or planning administration
- The confidence to communicate face-to-face with different teams, including out on the shop floor
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail while juggling several priorities at once
- Good general IT skills.

Interested?

Click Apply to find out more, or call the office to discuss.

You can OPT OUT at any time; full details are in our Privacy Policy at (url removed) or find the policy in the Sigma website footer. Location and postcode of the advert are approximate. title: Accounts Administrator (30 hours - negotiable) - Financial Services Tech Company
description:
IntaPeople are currently representing a Financial Services Technology client based in Bridgendwho are looking to recruit a reliable and experienced financial accounts administrator. You will have a good general understanding of basic accounting principles whilst having the ability to work alone or within a small finance team. Working closely with the Finance Director your core responsibilities will be to assist with general day-to-day accounts/finance admin duties within a fast paced environment.

This is a 30 hour working week but we are open to reduced or increased hours for the right person.

We re looking for candidates who have experience in:
- Proven experience within a accounts admin, finance admin or similar role
- At least 2+ years experience of working experience within this sector
- Experience using Excel
- You must be comfortable working on a Mac
- You must have experience working across multiple small businesses within a group
- Experience using accounting software tools such as Xero, Quickbooks or Sage
- The ability to work under fast paced, pressured environments
- Experience with VAT returns and the Microsoft Office package is desirable

Joining this small finance function, you ll be responsible for:
- Working closely with senior management and business directors
- Day-to-day accounts administration
- Working with accounting software tools such as software Xero, Sage and Quickbooks
- Locating and organising purchase invoices and receipts
- Update internal accounting databases and spreadsheets
- Running weekly and monthly reports for sales invoicing and self-billing
- Ensuring timely payments to affiliates and suppliers
- Reconciling payments received from affiliates
- Acting as a finance POC for internal and external clients
- Managing bank transactions
- Assisting with monthly reporting to agreed timeframes
- Assisting with VAT returns across the group of businesses

Role at a glance:
- Accounts/Finance Administrator - Reduced hours 30 hours per week (open to negotiating up or down to suit needs)
- Bridgend Office based - Monday - Friday
- Starting hourly rate of between £15 - £16 per hour depending on experience
- Modern working environment
- Length of service rewards
- Start date ASAP
- One stage interview process - onsite

For more information, click APPLY now.

title: After Sales Coordinator
description:
AfterSales Coordinator

Maesteg

Salary negotiable depending on experience

We are looking for a proactive and customer focused Aftersales /Customer Resolution Coordinator to join our client s Commercial team

In this role, you will manage customer complaints, returns, credits and aftersales issues, ensuring timely and effective resolutions. Working collaboratively with teams across the business, you will investigate problems, identify root causes and support continuous improvements to their products, processes and customer experience.

Key responsibilities
- Manage customer complaints, returns, credits and aftersales queries from start to finish.
- Investigate issues, identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
- Maintain clear and professional communication with customers.
- Work with internal teams to resolve commercial, product and delivery issues.
- Analyse customer feedback and aftersales data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
- Maintain accurate records, reports and procedures.

The Person
- Organised, analytical and confident managing customer issues, with a strong focus on finding solutions and delivering excellent customer service.
- Experienced in customer service, complaints handling or aftersales support.
- Strong problem solver, investigative and communication skills.
- Experienced in analysing data and preparing reports.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using CRM or similar systems.

Experience in manufacturing, construction products, logistics, quality management or continuous improvement would be advantageous but not essential

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic, reliable, and experienced Medical Receptionist to join our friendly and supportive team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a busy environment, and is committed to delivering excellent patient care and customer service. The role is primarily 8:30am to 5:30pm , although flexibility is required as you will occasionally work 8:00am to 6:30pm as part of a rota system . Key Duties and Responsibilities Provide a professional and efficient reception service, ensuring the main reception desk is covered at all times. Answer and manage incoming telephone calls, dealing with patient enquiries in a courteous and confidential manner. Book, amend, and cancel patient appointments in line with practice procedures. Undertake a range of general administrative duties to support the smooth running of the practice. Scan and accurately code both electronic and paper clinical correspondence in accordance with practice protocols and agreed timescales. Enter coded information into the practice clinical system where appropriate. Oversee the distribution of clinical results in line with practice protocols. Ensure all data entry is completed accurately and complies with current guidelines and procedures. Sort and organise patient records and correspondence in chronological order in preparation for summarisation. File paper records promptly and accurately once summarisation has been completed. Liaise with clinical staff regarding any coding queries or issues to ensure accuracy and continuity of patient records. Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with all relevant policies, procedures, and data protection requirements. Main Duties/Key Tasks: Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Manage data quality issues. Support the practice clinical audit program.

title: Receptionist
description: Want to make a real difference and have a truly rewarding career? JoinNHS Wales Shared Services Partnership (NWSSP)and be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We are looking for an enthusiastic, committed and friendly individual to join our Corporate Services team, as a Receptionist, at Matrix House, Swansea. This is a key role in ensuring the smooth running of our reception and front of house services. This means being able to communicate confidently in routine workplace situations, including welcoming visitors, answering and transferring telephone calls, taking and passing on messages, and responding to straightforward enquiries in Welsh. Act as the first point of contact for staff, visitors, and contractors. Manage a busy reception area, switchboard and deliveries. Maintain accurate records and stock control systems, for example, stationery items. Co-ordinate meeting room bookings and visitor access. Ensure compliance with data protection and confidentiality policies. Deliver excellent customer service and promote a positive image of NWSSP. To be responsible for providing clerical assistance to the Finance and Corporate Services Directorate and an effective reception service for NWSSP, including, but not limited to, all administrative tasks and communication tasks. Ensuring that friendly, efficient and professional service is provided at all times, which contributes to the delivery of an effective and customer focussed organisation. The post holder is expected to prioritise, manage their time well and demonstrate a high degree of flexibility. Handling sensitive and confidential information. The postholder will consistently deliver a client focussed service promoting good customer service and effective working relationships.
